# MCP to Prod

> The living FastMCP kit for shipping production MCP servers: a FastMCP 4.1.x template (stdio + Streamable HTTP), auth patterns, tool-design rules with a linter, golden-prompt evals, OpenTelemetry/logging, agent skills, and a Cloud Run deploy guide. Targets MCP spec 2026-07-28.

## Start
- [README](README.md): tree, quickstart, what's inside
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): repo map, commands, rules for coding agents

## Docs
- [Tool design](docs/tool-design.md): naming, descriptions, schemas, errors, pagination, idempotency
- [Auth](docs/auth.md): MCP_AUTH none/static/jwt, JWKS, Protected Resource Metadata, secrets
- [Evals](docs/evals.md): golden prompts, offline and live modes, CI
- [Observability](docs/observability.md): JSON logs, traces, starter alerts
- [Deploy to Cloud Run](docs/deploy-cloud-run.md)
- [Connect clients](docs/connect.md): Claude Code, Cursor, skills
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)
